descriptions.inProgress: Sejan told me since I brought the food, I'll have to distribute them to the good people in this town, and asked me to drop some food on a random house when no one's watching. Since the town is also full of crazy thieves stealing things from others, I'll have to find a house where it's not a thief's house.
descriptions.completed: I gave food to the suffering residents of Ariant. I think I proved my worth, but Sejan still wasn't so sure.
